build_demucs_model: build a Demucs source separation model with configurable encoder-decoder depth and DConv residual branches
create_BLSTM_module: create a bidirectional LSTM module with optional chunked processing for long sequences
create_DConv_residual_branch: create a dilated convolution residual branch with optional attention and LSTM layers
create_LocalState_attention: create a local state attention module with decaying temporal window constraints
rescale_conv_weights: rescale convolution layer weights to adjust their standard deviation to a target reference value
